verdict.rationale: Orrick publishes some jurisdiction-specific self-service material: a Germany-specific Incorporation Questionnaire form and a European Startup Health Check tool in Tech Studio, which reports 300+ articles. It also runs a global equity compensation practice that spans jurisdictions, but that is an advisory service, not published content. None of the evidence shows published guidance on the specific instruments the story names, so support is thin and largely implied. Missing for 10: published content on UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules and French BSPCE; country-specific equity/instrument guides; independent corroboration of jurisdiction-specific publications.
